comments.author: Curious
comments.body:
I know I'm replying to a month old comment but I thought I'd reply anyway.

In my experience, everything China likes is a pain in the butt to obtain without high skill ranks, skills of which are hard to rank compared to many other trade skills.

China likes Marble Sculpture, Musk, Fine Clothing, Jewellery, and Western Books.

Best place to get Marble Sculptures would be between Genoa and Pisa. Only problem is that you can only buy like, 15 or so at a time without art trading.

Musk can only be bought in Calicut and Cochin. Again, you can only by a small amount at a time without perfume trading. I've got a total rank of 14 counting the boosters I have and I can only buy 65 or so at a time. It's also got pirates sailing around it half the time so that's another con.

Fine Clothing is only sold in 2 ports and they're not close to each other so port resetting is needed in this case. Just like the others, they are hard to obtain even with a high crafts rank.

Jewellry is even worse than Fine Clothing.

Western Books are also a pain. They're only sold in Amsterdam and Lisbon so port hopping is out of the question. It's a little more forgiving if you don't have Sundries Trading as you can buy about 30-35, depending on your nationality. The only problem is, Western Books are the only trade good you can buy that are classified as sundries. All other sundries goods are Nanban only. So as you can imagine, ranking the sundries skill is really hard, at least for now. You can also make Western Books but collecting the mats for it and what all is more trouble than buying them.

There are other goods that China likes, but these are just the more easier ones to get...

comments.author: Curious
comments.body: There is a little bit of balance going on when you think about it. Because it is so easy to get wine for Japan, much more players trade in Japan. This means that you have a much lower chance of getting a decent trade if you bring wine to Japan. However, if you take the extra time to stock up on something like Musk or Marble Statues, you're virtually guaranteed a 1:1 trade every time because no one else is doing what you're doing. At least that's my experience, I rarely trade in Japan nowadays because of the instability factor.
